review_scope: Scientific framing, intended difficulty, necessary field definitions, minimal output request and solver-only exports. Verification implementation is assessed separately.
supersedes: Version 2 removed the protocol but retained excessive checker-specific schemas and directed material-holdout decisions. That endorsement is superseded; the prior review is archived under legacy_v2/.

difficulty_assessment.basis: Design-level expert review; empirical pass rates across scientific-agent systems have not been measured.
nontrivial_decisions_left_to_solver: assessment of related spectra, material identifiers and missing information
difficulty_assessment.scientific_scope: The five substantive questions are retained. Comparisons, interpretation and uncertainty still require executable analysis; detailed checker bookkeeping and explicit material-holdout instructions are removed.

questions.question: Q1
questions.research_objective: Determine the reliability of uncommon coordination-environment prediction and the empirical benefit or tradeoffs of imbalance treatment.
questions.required_work: Distribution audit, meaningful modeling comparison, minority-class diagnosis, defensible evaluation and uncertainty.

questions.question: Q2
questions.research_objective: Establish where spectral distance inference becomes unreliable, including unusual environments.
questions.required_work: Regression, justified regime definitions, signed and absolute error diagnosis, defensible evaluation and uncertainty.

questions.question: Q3
questions.research_objective: Assess incremental local-charge information beyond white-line position.
questions.required_work: A fair spectral-versus-peak predictive study, out-of-sample comparative evidence, baselines and uncertainty; full spectra need not win.

questions.question: Q4
questions.research_objective: Develop a multiscale representation and test predictive utility and property-specific interpretation.
questions.required_work: Representation design, three-target comparison, physical energy mapping and validation beyond importance rankings.

questions.question: Q5
questions.research_objective: Determine which predictive and interpretive conclusions survive intensity-scale removal.
questions.required_work: A controlled normalization study, fitting/sampling sensitivity, independent localization validation and scientifically comparable stability evidence.

resolved_findings.finding: A long audit-specific schema dominated the research prompts.
resolved_findings.resolution: Prompts retain filenames for report, predictions and membership, with record/model/property/split identification only; no JSON schema, condition enums or fixed metric collection.

resolved_findings.finding: Provenance wording was abstract and directed material-holdout choices.
resolved_findings.resolution: Background explains metadata.id and metadata.origin directly. The task leaves the evaluation design and implications of missing identifiers to the solver.

resolved_findings.finding: Q2 and Q3 still explicitly demanded generalization to unseen materials.
resolved_findings.resolution: Those clauses were replaced by requirements to assess reliability, strength of evidence and uncertainty; no particular split unit is prescribed.

fair_adjudication.numerical_check_role: Reconstruct released labels and inspect record-linked predictions and declared data membership. The evaluator must adapt to documented column names and cannot impose omitted legacy schemas or fixed metric collections.
fair_adjudication.scientific_check_role: Rerun code and examine whether the chosen design, comparisons, uncertainty and evidence support the stated conclusions. Claims of new-material generalization require appropriate evidence; every answer is not required to make that claim.
fair_adjudication.allowed_variation: Defensible alternative filtering, splitting, models, features, metrics, tuning, uncertainty procedures and negative or mixed conclusions.
fair_adjudication.source_limitation_for_reviewer: Known material identifiers occur only for source label scrape; feff records lack identifiers. This limits claims the data can establish, but is not an automatic requirement for a particular partitioning scheme.
fair_adjudication.review_separation: This question-quality review does not certify the verifier implementation; consult the separate checker review.

isolation.required_boundary: Use solver-only exports and prevent access to the review repository, public site and reference artifacts.
isolation.export_contains: Each export contains prompt.md and exactly eight gzip JSONL files; no evaluator artifacts.

prompt_hash_canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON containing title and prompt only, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(comma,colon).
execution_claim: All five solver-only exports were generated and inspected for this revision. Existing worked-example results are historical evidence for those analyses; this review does not claim fresh execution or scientific acceptance.
